title: Restore phase covariance in sharp four-axis Gaussian rounding (no new κ)
body:
Complete the phase-covariance obligation left by #6574 while retaining its sharp Euclidean error sqrt(8)h, exact complex sum, zero and literal inverse. An explicit 2,048-class real quotient and 1,008 negation-orbit witnesses give F(ix)=iF(x). Prove the period index is minimal for odd affine-period real maps; the native minimum is 2^22, including coupled corrections. These are quotient indices, not memory lower bounds.

Bind the new map to #6509's actual retained two-/three-call ports. At f=4, certified coordinate errors allow g=q+1 instead of g=q+3: two fractional bits and two retained word bits saved, with unchanged external requests and exact dirty-bank return. The direct bill includes transforms, classification, table access, wrappers and scratch work. #6755's concurrent review identifies these obligations but does not endorse this result.

Base: 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a.
#6574: 48e312ff18d5b66b0969148f615fdf5ce0f92edd.
#6509: a4173e810c4d34a1d13b9745af123ad0ec6cfed5.
All source/blob/hash pins are retained.

Reproduce (CPython 3.12, stdlib):
```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/four-axis-phase-covariant-grid
```
Expected: PASS_PHASE_COVARIANT_GRID, PASS_FOUR_AXIS_RETAINED_PORTS and PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE.

Executed normal/-O: all 2,048 source and target classes; independent rational lattice normal forms; 4,096 native-coefficient fixtures; 11 core controls; 16 port-direction cases, 40 actual cuts, four reduced-grid boundary cases and five caller controls. False radius, target collisions, wrong inverse/axis and overflow reject. Separate proof review, committed bytes/modes, export integrity and Git-free replays pass. Complete remote tree matches.

No new κ. The certificate explicitly fails F^4=I; its exact witness is retained. Exact group order, graph consistency, physical/tape/compiler pricing and supplier admission remain open; all five selected assumptions remain. No human/proof-kernel acceptance, hosted CI or selected cold replay; full-history preflight refused the shallow checkout.

By @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and separate construction/review roles. Credit Nick Petalas (#6574), Ali Romman (#6509/#6534/#6536), JoyboyBrian (#5485), David Ganz/Dugongue (#5815), #4743 and retained native lineage. Apache-2.0.
